nodes.label: Desert Arena Background
nodes.description: Isometric fantasy battle arena set in an arid desert landscape. The central arena floor is a broad open sandy ellipse of warm tan and ochre tones. Surrounding the perimeter are ancient stone ruins including crumbling archways, broken columns, and scattered stonework. Cacti and sparse desert vegetation dot the corners. Purple/violet fabric tents or banners are visible near ruined structures. Rocky sandstone formations frame the upper-left corner. The art style is detailed digital painting with a warm, sun-bleached color palette dominated by oranges, tans, and dusty yellows.
nodes.fantasy_theme: ancient ruins, desert wasteland, gladiatorial arena
nodes.art_style: isometric digital painting, fantasy game background

nodes.label: Forest Arena Background
nodes.description: Isometric fantasy battle arena set in a lush forest glade. The central arena floor is an open grassy ellipse with a worn dirt clearing at the center. Dense forest surrounds the perimeter with tall evergreen and deciduous trees, thick bushes, colorful wildflowers (purple lupines, red and white small flowers), and moss-covered rocks. Stone ruins including broken pillars and crumbled walls are integrated into the forest edges. A fallen log is visible in the upper-left corner. The color palette is rich greens, earthy browns, and accents of floral color. The mood is verdant, natural, and serene yet suitable for combat.
nodes.fantasy_theme: enchanted forest, ancient glade, druidic arena
nodes.art_style: isometric digital painting, fantasy game background

nodes.label: Snow Arena Background
nodes.description: Isometric fantasy battle arena set in a frozen winter landscape. The central arena floor is a broad open expanse of compacted snow and ice with subtle blue-white tonal variation. Surrounding the perimeter are snow-covered rocky cliffs and outcroppings, snow-laden evergreen trees, bare skeletal winter trees, and crumbling stone ruins including archways and broken walls partially buried in snow. Frozen debris and icy rocks scatter the edges. The color palette is cool and desaturated: whites, pale blues, steel grays, and dark blue-greens of the fir trees. The mood is frigid, bleak, and foreboding.
nodes.fantasy_theme: frozen tundra, winter ruins, ice arena
nodes.art_style: isometric digital painting, fantasy game background

nodes.label: Hive Logo
nodes.description: A bold, flat-design logo consisting of a red diamond/rhombus shape on the left combined with three rightward-pointing chevron arrows in the same vibrant red on the right. The chevrons are stacked and create a sense of forward momentum or progression. The overall silhouette resembles a stylized hexagonal or hive-like form when viewed together. The design is minimal, geometric, and uses solid red (#CC0000 or similar) on a white/transparent background. This is the logo for the Hive blockchain/social platform, recognizable as the official Hive brand mark.
nodes.represents: Hive blockchain platform brand identity; the logo combines a diamond with triple chevrons suggesting connectivity, community, and forward movement

nodes.label: Horizon Forge Arena Background Collection
nodes.description: A set of three isometric fantasy game arena backgrounds representing distinct biome environments: desert, forest, and snow. Each shares the same compositional structure (central open elliptical combat floor surrounded by thematic environmental elements and ancient ruins), suggesting they are interchangeable battle stages in the Horizon Forge game.
